questions.question: According to the ITU Internet Report 2005 discussed in the lecture, the future Internet is expected to become wider and more complex mainly because:
options: Humans will completely stop using the Internet
Most Internet traffic may flow between devices and different kinds of things
Only desktop computers will remain connected
Internet communication will be restricted to email services
questions.explanation: The ITU report describes a future where humans may become a minority as generators and receivers of traffic. Instead, communication will increasingly happen between devices and “things,” forming the Internet of Things.
questions.source: See lecture 1 Introduction to IoT — Part-I @ 03:10

questions.question: Which of the following are characteristics of IoT systems?
options: Efficient and scalable architecture
Unambiguous naming and addressing
Presence of sleeping nodes, mobile nodes, and non-IP devices
Guaranteed continuous connectivity for every device at all times
questions.explanation: IoT systems require scalable architecture, clear naming and addressing, and must support heterogeneous devices such as sleeping nodes, mobile nodes, and non-IP devices. However, IoT systems may have intermittent connectivity, so option d is incorrect.
questions.source: See lecture 1: Introduction to IoT — Part-I @ 06:05

questions.question: In the lecture, “Smart Dust” refers to:
options: A cloud storage model for IoT data
A large-scale wireless router used in smart cities
Very tiny computing devices that can be sprayed or injected for sensing purposes
A type of IPv6 address used in IoT networks
questions.explanation: Smart Dust refers to extremely small computing devices, smaller than a grain of sand, that can be used to measure chemicals in soil or diagnose problems in the human body.
questions.source: See lecture 1 Introduction to IoT — Part-I @ 10:40

questions.question: Which statement best explains the relation between IoT and M2M communication?
options: IoT and M2M are exactly the same
M2M is broader than IoT because it includes people and applications
M2M is a part of IoT, while IoT has a broader scope of interactions
IoT does not include machine-to-machine interaction
questions.explanation: M2M focuses mainly on communication among machines and devices. IoT is broader because it includes interactions between things, people, applications, and systems.
questions.source: See lecture 1 Introduction to IoT — Part-I @ 19:30

questions.question: State whether the following statement is True or False. Statement: In the Web of Things, IoT sensors are replaced completely by cloud databases.
options: True
False
questions.explanation: The Web of Things does not replace sensors. Sensors remain responsible for collecting physical-world data, while web technologies help expose and access IoT resources.
questions.source: See lecture 1 Introduction to IoT — Part-I @ 22:50

questions.question: In an IoT network configuration, local addresses may be valid only within a gateway’s domain. The same local address may even appear under another gateway. The main advantage of this strategy is:
options: It increases unnecessary address consumption
It helps conserve address space
It removes the requirement of a gateway
It prevents any device from communicating with the Internet
questions.explanation: Using locally valid addresses within a gateway’s domain allows address reuse across different gateway domains. This helps avoid unnecessary wastage of global addresses.
questions.source: See lecture 2 Introduction to IoT — Part-II @ 05:30

questions.question: Which of the following functions are associated with IoT gateways in the addressing strategy discussed in the lecture?
options: Providing Internet connectivity
Supporting IoT LAN intra-connectivity
Obtaining upstream address prefixes using mechanisms such as DHCPv6
Delegating addresses to nodes using SLAAC
questions.explanation: IoT gateways can provide Internet connectivity and IoT LAN intra-connectivity. They may obtain upstream prefixes through DHCPv6 and delegate them to nodes using SLAAC.
questions.source: See lecture 2 Introduction to IoT — Part-II @ 09:40

questions.question: Which of the following is true about IPv6 compared to IPv4?
options: IPv6 uses dotted decimal notation
IPv6 has a smaller address space than IPv4
IPv6 uses hexadecimal notation and supports a much larger address space
IPv6 requires broadcast addresses in the same way as IPv4
questions.explanation: IPv4 uses 32-bit addresses and dotted decimal notation, whereas IPv6 uses 128- bit addresses and hexadecimal notation. This makes IPv6 more suitable for large-scale IoT addressing.
questions.source: See lecture 2 Introduction to IoT — Part-II @ 16:50

questions.question: Which statement correctly represents the design expectation from a good sensor?
options: It should influence the measured property significantly
It should respond strongly to unrelated physical properties
It should be sensitive to the measured property and should not disturb it
It should always produce random output
questions.explanation: A good sensor should measure the desired property, remain insensitive to unrelated properties, and should not influence or alter the measured quantity.

questions.question: Which of the following statements about sensor resolution are correct?
options: Sensor resolution is the smallest change that the sensor can detect
For a digital sensor, resolution is related to the smallest digital output change it can process
Sensor resolution and sensor accuracy always refer to exactly the same property
Sensor accuracy does not depend only on resolution
questions.explanation: Resolution refers to the smallest detectable change in the measured quantity. In digital sensors, it is related to the smallest digital output step. However, accuracy and resolution are not the same; a high-resolution sensor may still be inaccurate if it has bias or calibration errors.

questions.question: State True or False. An accelerometer that measures acceleration along the x, y, and z coordinate axes is classified as a vector sensor.
options: True
False
questions.explanation: A vector sensor measures quantities that have both magnitude and direction or orientation. Since an accelerometer measures acceleration components along different coordinate axes, such as x, y, and z, it is classified as a vector sensor.

questions.question: A sensor gives different output for the same input value depending on whether that input was reached by increasing or decreasing the measured quantity. This error is called:
options: Quantization error
Hysteresis error
IPv6 translation error
Gateway prefix error
questions.explanation: Hysteresis error occurs when the sensor output depends on the previous input history. The same present input may give different readings depending on whether the input was approached from a lower or higher value.

questions.question: State True or False A hydraulic actuator can produce considerable force because liquids are nearly incompressible.
options: False
True
questions.explanation: A hydraulic actuator uses hydraulic fluid to generate mechanical motion. Since liquids are nearly incompressible, hydraulic actuators can exert large forces.

questions.question: Which of the following statements are correct about Shape Memory Polymer actuators?
options: They may respond to stimuli such as light, heat, electrical, magnetic, pH, or moisture changes
They can show high strain recovery
They may have properties such as low density and biocompatibility
They are used only as passive temperature sensors
questions.explanation: Shape Memory Polymer actuators can respond to different stimuli and are known for features such as low density, high strain recovery, biocompatibility, and biodegradability. They are actuator materials, not merely passive temperature sensors.

questions.question: State whether the following statement is True or False. Statement: According to the IoT implementation example discussed in the lecture, data gathered by a sensor travels through a gateway and a proxy server before arriving at the cloud server.
options: True
False
questions.explanation: In the example IoT implementation, the sensor first collects the data. The data then passes through the gateway and proxy server before reaching the cloud server for further processing and analytics.
questions.source: See Lecture 5: Basics of IoT Networking — Part-I @ 07:30
